_comment: FFU Builder Version Configuration - Single source of truth for all versioning

versioningPolicy.majorBump: Breaking changes to configs/scripts OR major milestones
versioningPolicy.minorBump: New user-facing features OR significant improvements
versioningPolicy.patchBump: Bug fixes OR any subcomponent version change

FFU.Common.description: Core logging, process execution, shared utilities - ThreadJob compatible (Find-ExecutableInPath, $function: drive instead of Get-Command)

FFU.Common.Logging.description: Structured logging with levels, JSON output, session correlation

FFUUI.Core.description: WPF UI framework with FFU file lock wait setting, VMware network settings, ShowVMConsole default true

FFU.Core.description: Core configuration, session tracking, credential security, schema validation, PowerShell best practices, WIM mount error handling, background job compatible output, build cancellation helper, ThreadJob safe logging, error handling reliability (REL-CORE-01)

FFU.ADK.description: Windows ADK validation and installation, background job compatible output

FFU.Drivers.description: Driver reliability (REL-DRV-01/02/03/04) - Exponential backoff retry, vendor-specific exit code classification, catalog caching with fallback, disk space pre-validation

FFU.Imaging.description: Imaging reliability (REL-IMG-01/02/03/04/05) - Disk space validation, partition state verification, FFU capture recovery, transient error retry, pre-validation for large operations

FFU.Media.description: ISO disk space pre-validation (REL-MED-03) - Test-ISOCreationReadiness estimates ISO size from WinPE folder, validates output destination space before oscdimg

FFU.Updates.description: Update reliability (REL-UPD-01/02/03/04) - Catalog query retry, MSU integrity validation, update application isolation, catalog cache management

FFU.VM.description: Checkpoint disk space validation (REL-VM-04), Test-CheckpointDiskSpace pre-validation, New-FFUVMCheckpoint with orphan cleanup

FFU.Messaging.description: Thread-safe messaging for UI/background job communication

FFU.Preflight.description: Enhanced WimMount failure detection - driver integrity check, altitude conflict detection, EDR/security software blocking detection with targeted remediation

FFU.Hypervisor.description: Service recovery (REL-HYP-04), Test-HypervisorService, Invoke-WithHypervisorRetry, automatic retry on service interruptions

FFU.BuildTest.description: Build testing and verification with elevated execution support (Start-FFUBuildListener, Invoke-FFUBuildElevated)

FFU.ConfigMigration.description: Configuration file migration and schema versioning, ThreadJob compatible ($function: instead of Get-Command)
